summary: Iteration 4 retest of the 4 fixes from iteration_3. Backend: ALL FIXED — 20/20 new targeted assertions in /app/backend/tests/test_oauth_fixes.py pass, plus 37/37 iteration-1/2/3 regressions (backend_test.py + test_oauth.py) still pass. TikTok host/paths are correct now: exchange_code against https://auth.tiktok-shops.com/api/v2/token/get returns the legitimate marketplace error 'invalid auth code', refresh returns 'can not find related auth record', and POST /stores/3/test (dummy app_key) returns 200 ok=false with detail.error="Invalid credentials. Invalid 'app_key' query parameter..." — no 'Invalid path' and no raw Python text anywhere. POST /stores/{id}/test now 400s with the exact expected messages for missing partner creds / missing access_token / missing shopee shop_id, and genuine marketplace errors come back as clean 200+ok=false with connection_status persisted as 'error'. Invalid / expired / platform-mismatched OAuth state now returns 303 to FRONTEND_STORES_URL?connect=error&msg=... for both shopee and tiktok callbacks. StoreOut.is_authorized present and false for all 4 seeded stores (placeholder tokens filtered), true when a real token is set, and neither access_token nor partner_key leak. Frontend: FIX #1 VERIFIED — with connection_status='error' the Manage Connection modal shows [data-testid=store-modal-test]; clicking it fires the real API, shows the clean 400 toast ('Shopee shop_id is missing — complete the OAuth handshake to link a shop') and the button stays visible afterwards. FIX #2 STILL BROKEN — /stores?connect=success&msg=... and connect=error&msg=... still render NO toast; the setTimeout(0) wrapper is cancelled by the effect's own cleanup. Proven by removing clearTimeout(t) as a temporary diagnostic (toast then rendered 'Connected · Shopee Main SG'); diagnostic reverted. All store rows reset to partner_id/partner_key/shop_id=null, connection_status='disconnected', seeded access_tokens restored.

integration_issues.issue: STILL FAILING after the setTimeout(0) fix. Stores.jsx lines 257-270: the effect schedules the toast with setTimeout(fn, 0), then synchronously calls setParams(params, {replace:true}) which changes the `params` dependency, so React re-runs the effect and first executes the previous cleanup `return () => clearTimeout(t)` — cancelling the pending toast before the 0ms timer can fire. On the second run `connect` is already gone so it early-returns. Net effect: still zero user feedback after returning from Shopee/TikTok. Verified for both connect=success and connect=error (5s wait each, no [data-sonner-toast]). Confirmed root cause by temporarily removing clearTimeout(t) -> green toast 'Connected · Shopee Main SG' rendered immediately (diagnostic reverted, file back to original). Suggested fix: capture the params ONCE outside the reactive deps (e.g. read window.location.search on mount with an empty dep array + a useRef guard) or drop the cleanup / use a module-level 'alreadyFired' ref instead of clearing the timer.

issues: Status badge reads ERROR while the box below still reads 'AUTHORIZED / Shop ID: —' even though is_authorized=false and shop_id is null — misleading. The green AUTHORIZED block is keyed on the same isAuthorized flag that now includes connection_status==='error'; consider labelling it 'TOKEN PRESENT' or hiding it when store.is_authorized is false.
Still no field to enter/edit shop_id (carry-over MEDIUM from iteration 3), so a Shopee store that never completed the handshake can never pass Test Connection from the UI.

Optional polish: don't show the green 'AUTHORIZED' block when store.is_authorized === false (currently shown for connection_status='error' with no token/shop_id).

tiktok.py: single _safe_json parse, pre-signing null guards, and code!=0 treated as error — all previous minor items addressed.

Test isolation note: /app/backend/tests/* mutate shared Store rows, and pytest.ini enables xdist (-n 2), which causes cross-worker interference (is_authorized test failed only under parallel run). Run the store/OAuth suites with -n 0 or give each suite its own store row.
Carry-over unfixed from iteration 2: shopee_sync._sync_cycle calls asyncio.run() inside a running loop; do not enable sync_enabled on a store until fixed.

rca_of_the_issue: Post-callback toast: useEffect([params, setParams]) schedules toast via setTimeout(...,0) but then calls setParams() in the same synchronous block; the params object identity changes, React tears down the effect (running clearTimeout(t)) before the macrotask fires, so the toast is discarded. Empirically confirmed: deleting clearTimeout(t) makes the toast render, restoring it makes it disappear again.
